name_input: MAHESHWARI MINING PVT LTD; MAHESHWARI MINING PRIVATE LIMITED; MMPL PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey page for MAHESHWARI MINING PRIVATE LIMITED (https://importkey.com/countries/india/maheshwari-mining-private-limited) reports "Total Shipments 6272 Records detected" and "Latest Cargo 2025-10-07", but every visible row is an INBOUND record into India, e.g. "2025-10-07 | QINGDAO FORMINE INTERNATIONAL TRADING CO., LTD. | MAHESHWARI MINING PRIVATE LIMITED | CHARGING VALVE BLOCK (PARTS OF MINING MACHINE) ... | SHANGHAI, China | Kolkata Air Cargo, India | 84819090 | 4632622". No outbound row with an Indian origin port and a foreign destination was seen. Source counter: page claims 6272 shipments; only 5 rows were rendered in the free view, all imports.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract record could be retrieved: web_search returned "no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)" on both queries, and eximpedia.app, trademo.com, zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com all returned HTTP 403. No domestic supply record was actually read, so this is null, not a negative finding.
note: Role per the trade records is buyer/importer of mining-machine spares (hydraulic valve blocks, diaphragms, gaskets, nozzles) from China, France, Belgium, Brazil and Italy — consistent with an equipment user/contract miner rather than an exporter. The declared HS 842520 (continuous miners for underground mining) does not match any observed record: the codes actually seen are 84819090, 39269099, 84841090, 84314990 and 84099990, all parts of mining machinery, and all on the import side. Per rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base with the code corrected to the observed parts codes and the verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Per rule 5: no export shipment with date, destination, HS code and B/L was found, and no domestic supply evidence was found either — следов поставок не найдено (no trace of supplies found) on the export side; domestic side is unknown rather than negative because the sources were unreachable, not because they were checked and empty. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any source I could open. The name variants MAHESHWARI MINING PVT LTD and MMPL PRIVATE LIMITED appear in ImportKey only as co-listed counterparty aliases in supplier/buyer address blocks (e.g. "MAHESHWARI MINING PRIVATE LIMITED, MMPL PRIVATE LIMITED"), not as separate shipment records; the 'Pvt Ltd' slug page rendered with no records at all.
